p: When the host loads with this on, its window starts guarding the region. The window keeps guarding it after the host unloads or is discarded, as on an unselected tab of a
, until the region closes, the window closes, a guarding host loads with the region in another window, or a host of the region turns this off. The window holds no host, and holds its regions weakly.

While a guarded region has entries, the window's close is cancelled and the regions are cleared one after another, in the order their hosts first loaded; the window closes when every clear commits. A guard that rejects, a cancelled clear or a superseded clear keeps the window open with its entries and asks no further regions, so a guard can confirm through a
in the same window. A close while a clear is still in flight joins it; a close after the clearing region stops transitioning starts a new check. A close that another
handler already cancelled is left alone, and a window whose regions are empty closes at once.
WPF ignores cancellation when
closes the windows, and doesn't raise
when the Windows session ends: those paths don't ask the guards. Close the main window instead of calling
